entries.summary: Vo Nguyen Giap Street is the beach road that gives Da Nang shape: hotels, palms, scooters, cafe fronts, long crossings, and My Khe beside the map.

entries.summary: Wonderlust is a bright cafe cool-down: clean counter, iced glass, minimalist table, and a short break between heat, walking, markets, beach time, or dinner.

entries.rationale: Wonderlust gives the cafe set a bright cool-down for walks, markets, beach time, and dinner gaps.

sections.title: A Bright Break Before Dinner
sections.body: Wonderlust is a cafe cool-down: a clean counter, an iced glass, and a table where Da Nang slows down for a minute.

sections.title: A Bright Cafe Stop
sections.body: Wonderlust fits the city's modern cafe side, where a clean counter and iced glass can steady heat, errands, or beach time.

sections.title: A Short Table Beats A Long Session

sections.title: Clean Cafe Break
sections.body: Wonderlust suits a day that needs a bright table more than a destination cafe. Order simply, sit long enough to cool down, then move on.

sections.title: The Cool-Down Is Enough
sections.body: You do not need to translate the name or build a route around it. The value is a clean, cool stop when the day needs one.

entries.summary: Yen Retreat is Da Nang's quieter outdoor edge: lawn, river, simple tents, mountains, and breathing room beyond the dense beach-and-bridge loop.
entries.context: The retreat is a weather-aware outdoor stop where the ride back matters as much as the quiet once you arrive.
entries.tip: The return belongs in the plan before the quiet fully takes over; the softer setting feels easier with transport handled.
entries.rationale: The calm nature mood stays clear while avoiding fragile operational details.

sections.title: The Quiet Outdoor Edge

sections.title: Weather And Ride Margin

sections.title: Return Plan Before The Quiet
